{{Top}}
{{Quote|Heard you broke the record doing the Sevari Sidestep. Got out with a cargo hold full of carsunum spice.|[[Bolabo Hujaan]], to [[Dash Rendar/Legends|Dash Rendar]]|<ref name="All the Extras">{{WEGCite|story=All the Extras|book=Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook}}</ref>}}
'''Carsunum''',<ref name="AJ2" /> also known as '''black spice''',<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> was a rare and highly illegal [[Spice/Legends|spice]] variant mined on [[Sevarcos II]]. It was hard to find, usually located deep within mines under layers of solid rock.<ref name="AJ2">{{JournalCite|2|The Free-Trader's Guide to Sevarcos}}</ref><ref name="guide">''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref> 

Controversial legends said that carsunum aided in meditation, granting insight, as well as improved health and longevity. In reality, use of carsunum granted a temporary boost of both mental and physical abilities as well as a pleasurable sense of well-being; however, once the spice hit ended, the user lost their mood and energy, and sometimes ended up [[Poison/Legends|poisoned]], even with fatal results.<ref name="guide" />

The mysterious [[Healer's Guild]] used a forgotten recipe of carsunum (sometimes mixed with [[ryll/Legends|ryll]]) to control and prevent the proliferation of [[hive virus]]es like the one that infected the crew of the [[Katana fleet|''Katana'' fleet]].<ref name="AJ2" /><ref name="guide" />

Because of its dangerous effects, carsunum was illegal, and also rare. A dose of 10 [[gram]]s costed a thousand [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|Imperial Credits]] in the [[black market/Legends|black market]].<ref name="guide" />
